questions.question: After renouncing his prosperous home and entering the forest, to whom did King Vidura address his questions?
questions.explanation: "After renouncing his prosperous home and entering the forest, King Vidura, the great devotee, asked this question of His Grace Maitreya Rsi." (SB 3.1.1)

questions.question: Why did King Dhrtarastra set fire to the lacquer house to burn the fatherless Pandavas?

options.text: Under the influence of impious desires to nourish his dishonest sons

questions.explanation: "King Dhrtarastra became blind under the influence of impious desires to nourish his dishonest sons, and thus he set fire to the lacquer house to burn his fatherless nephews, the Pandavas." (SB 3.1.6)

questions.question: Whose hair did Duhsasana grab, an abominable act the King did not forbid?
questions.explanation: "The King did not forbid his son Duhsasana's abominable action of grabbing the hair of Draupadi, the wife of the godly King Yudhisthira." (SB 3.1.7)

questions.question: After Yudhisthira was unfairly defeated in gambling, why did he go off to the forest?

options.text: Because he was banished by Krsna
Because he had taken the vow of truthfulness

questions.explanation: "But because he had taken the vow of truthfulness, he went off to the forest." (SB 3.1.8)

questions.question: Whom did Vidura describe as breathing heavily like a snake while waiting with Yudhisthira?
questions.explanation: "He is waiting with his younger brothers, among whom is the revengeful Bhima, breathing heavily like a snake." (SB 3.1.11)

questions.question: Of whom did Vidura tell Dhrtarastra that he was maintaining offense personified as his infallible son?
questions.explanation: "You are maintaining offense personified, Duryodhana, as your infallible son, but he is envious of Lord Krsna." (SB 3.1.13)

questions.question: When Vidura gave his wise instructions, who insulted him, swollen with anger and with trembling lips?
questions.explanation: "Vidura, whose personal character was esteemed by respectable persons, was insulted by Duryodhana, who was swollen with anger and whose lips were trembling." (SB 3.1.14)

questions.question: After being insulted, what did Vidura do upon leaving his brother's palace?

options.text: He drew his sword and fought
He placed his bow on the door and quit the palace

questions.explanation: "Vidura placed his bow on the door and quit his brother's palace." (SB 3.1.16)

questions.question: After leaving Hastinapura, what did Vidura take shelter of?
questions.explanation: "After leaving Hastinapura, he took shelter of many places of pilgrimages, which are the Lord's lotus feet." (SB 3.1.17)

questions.question: At which place of pilgrimage did Vidura learn that all his relatives had died?
questions.explanation: "At the place of pilgrimage at Prabhasa, it came to his knowledge that all his relatives had died due to violent passion." (SB 3.1.21)

questions.question: After learning of his relatives' deaths, in which direction did Vidura proceed, toward which river?

options.text: West, where the river Sarasvati flows

questions.explanation: "After this he proceeded west, where the river Sarasvati flows." (SB 3.1.21)

questions.question: How many places of pilgrimage on the bank of the river Sarasvati did Vidura visit?
questions.explanation: "On the bank of the river Sarasvati there were eleven places of pilgrimage." (SB 3.1.22)

questions.question: On the bank of which river did Vidura meet Uddhava, the great devotee of Lord Krsna?
questions.explanation: "At last he reached the bank of the Yamuna, where he happened to meet Uddhava, the great devotee of Lord Krsna." (SB 3.1.24)

questions.question: Of whom was Uddhava formerly a great student?
questions.explanation: "Vidura embraced him [Uddhava], who was a constant companion of Lord Krsna and formerly a great student of Brhaspati's." (SB 3.1.25)

questions.question: Pradyumna, the commander in chief of the Yadus, was who in a former life?
questions.explanation: "How is Pradyumna, the commander in chief of the Yadus, who was Cupid in a former life?" (SB 3.1.28)

questions.question: In a previous birth, Samba was born as whom, in the womb of the wife of Lord Siva?
questions.explanation: "In a previous birth he was born as Karttikeya in the womb of the wife of Lord Siva, and now he has been born in the womb of Jambavati." (SB 3.1.30)

questions.question: From whom did Yuyudhana learn the intricacies of the military art?
questions.explanation: "He learned the intricacies of the military art from Arjuna and attained the transcendental destination which is very difficult to reach even for great renouncers." (SB 3.1.31)

questions.question: Which devotee fell down on the dust of a road marked with the footprints of Lord Krsna, due to his ecstasy of transcendental love?
questions.explanation: "He once lost his mental equilibrium due to his ecstasy of transcendental love and fell down on the dust of a road which was marked with the footprints of Lord Krsna." (SB 3.1.32)

questions.question: About whom did Vidura lament as one who 'rebelled against his brother after death' and drove Vidura out of his own house?
questions.explanation: "I simply lament for him [Dhrtarastra] who rebelled against his brother after death." (SB 3.1.41)

questions.question: In whose family did the unborn Lord appear by His causeless mercy, only for their interest?
questions.explanation: "Only for their interest did He appear in the family of His unalloyed devotees the Yadus." (SB 3.1.45)

questions.question: When Krishna came to Hastinapura before the war to make a peace treaty, He first went to whose house?
When Vidura spoke words of wisdom to Dhritarashtra, what happened?

options.text: Duryodhana angrily asked him to leave the place

questions.question: After leaving Hastinapura, Vidura did what?

options.text: Went in seclusion in the forest

questions.question: At which place did Vidura learn that all his relatives had died?
Vidura met Uddhava at the bank of which river?
Vidura asked Uddhava about the welfare of whom?
Who was Samba in his previous birth?
